blurb: Lafayette Reservoir Recreation Area offers activities including hiking on over 10 miles of trails, fishing with required permits, and boat rentals. The park has picnic tables, BBQ grills, and a children's playground. Dogs are allowed on leash, and there are specific rules to prevent invasive mussels in the water.
extraNote: Boat rentals require a $40 deposit · Boat rentals are first-come, first-served and boats must be docked by 5:00 pm · Personal boats require a $4 one-day launch fee and $6 invasive mussel inspection fee valid for 30 days · 50% discount on boat rentals for seniors and disabled on non-holiday weekdays · Visitor Center for boat rentals and fishing permits · Year-round
